# Latency-Sensitive Tensor Offloading Plan for Nemotron-H on 12GB GPU

## Executive Summary
To maintain interactive latency on a 12GB GPU while supporting the full Nemotron-H MoE architecture, we must strategically offload MoE and Mamba computation to CPU RAM. The 12GB constraint forces selective retention of high-frequency tensors while overflowing periodic/large MoE weights. This plan targets the `final_q4ks_autofit_64k-coding-3` benchmark configuration.

## 1. Tensor Retention Strategy (12GB GPU Limit)

### Retained on GPU (latency-critical, < 8GB total):
| Tensor | Shape | Rationale |
|--------|-------|-----------|
| `tok_embd` | `{n_embd, n_vocab}` | Embedding lookup is the dominant prefill cost; must stay on GPU |
| `output_norm` | `{n_embd}` | Final RMSNorm before lm_head |
| `output` | `{n_embd, n_vocab}` | Output projection (can be duplicated from tok_embd) |
| `attn_norm` per layer | `{n_embd}` | Attention normalization runs every layer |
| `wo` per layer | `{n_embd_head_k * n_head_i, n_embd}` | Attention output projection |
| `ssm_in` per recurrent layer | `{n_embd, d_in_proj}` | Mamba input projection (recurrent layers only) |
| `ssm_conv1d` per recurrent layer | `{d_conv, d_inner + 2*n_group*d_state}` | Mamba convolution |
| `ssm_a`, `ssm_d` per recurrent layer | `{1, n_ssm_head}` | Mamba state matrices |
| `ssm_norm` per recurrent layer | `{d_inner / n_group, n_group}` | Mamba normalization |
| `ssm_out` per recurrent layer | `{d_inner, n_embd}` | Mamba output projection |
| `ffn_down` / `ffn_up` per non-MoE layer | Variable | Standard MLP weights |

| Tensor | Shape | Offload Reason |
